remark: The try-catch block catches IndexOutOfBoundsException that may be thrown by the get() call in addCurrentProcessedInput (via call chain) and by the explicit get() on editedMediaItems. A single try-catch covers the entire lambda body, which includes all potentially problematic statements.
analysis: The code snippet runs inside a Runnable posted to a Handler. It calls addCurrentProcessedInput() and later accesses editedMediaItems.get(currentMediaItemIndex) after incrementing the index and potentially resetting it to 0 if the list size equals the index. Both calls can throw IndexOutOfBoundsException: addCurrentProcessedInput throws if currentMediaItemIndex is out of bounds (e.g., below 0 or >= size), and get throws if the list is empty (size 0) and index is 0 after reset. There is no existing exception handling in the snippet. Since these are runtime exceptions that can crash the application, it is advisable to catch them locally to prevent unhandled exceptions on the Handler thread.
